sources.snippet: Model Overview Bluebird 1.5 Base is a compact, decoder-only causal language model in the Project Bluebird family. With 742,528,520 parameters and a 32,768-token context window, it combines local causal attention with a compressed, chunked-memory mechanism for accessing information from earlier parts of a sequence.
